sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr
Counsel for Applicant :- Gautam,Ila Deol,Mohd. Shamim,Rajendra Kumar Ratnakar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Chandra Pal Singh,G.A.,Prem Narayan Singh,Ravi Yadav,Vikas
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed praying for quashing the entire proceedings including the cognizance/summoning order 6.3.2020 issued against the applicants by the learned A.C.J.M. Bagpat/Civil Judge (S.D.), Bagpat, in Criminal Case No. 1549 of 2020 arising out of Case crime no. 0395 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.c. P.S. Singhawali Ahir, district Bagpat.
It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that all the disputes and differences have been settled between the parties.
The compromise was filed before the concerned court and vide its order dated 12.03.2024, it is brought on record, the compromise has been verified by the Court.
At this stage, learned counsel further submitted that continuation of the proceedings of the aforesaid case will be an abuse of process of law.

No fruitful purpose would be served keeping the matter Naushad And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55052298/
1 pending.

4.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 submits that since the dispute between the parties has been settled, opposite party no.2 has no objection if the proceedings of the aforesaid complaint case pending before the trial court is quashed.
5. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the entire record.

6. In all the aforesaid cases, the Apex Court has laid down the law that criminal proceedings may be quashed even in non-compoundable cases by the High Court in exercise of its extraordinary jurisdiction to restore peace between the parties and in case the justice so demands.

According to Hon'ble Supreme Court, if the offence involve private dispute between the parties of commercial nature or matrimonial dispute and it is not related to heinous offence, the proceedings may be quashed.

7. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably and mutually settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply be a waste of time if the aforesaid case is permitted to continue till its logical conclusion.
8. In view of the above, the Application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

9. The entire proceedings ofcognizance/summoning order 6.3.2020 issued against the applicants by the learned A.C.J.M. Bagpat/Civil Judge (S.D.), Bagpat, in Criminal Case No. 1549 of 2020 arising out of Case crime no. 0395 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.c. P.S. Singhawali Ahir, District Bagpat, against the applicants are quashed in terms of compromise arrived at between the parties.
